translations.web: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.
translations.bsb: Your corpses will be food for all the birds of the air and beasts of the earth, with no one to scare them away.
translations.kjv: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.
translations.asv: And thy dead body shall be food unto all birds of the heavens, and unto the beasts of the earth; and there shall be none to frighten them away.
